title: dect_nr: cvg: Add initial CVG parsing
description:
* Added the dissect_cvg_pdu function for CVG layer parsing.
* Added parsing for CVG Ext Coding and two IE types.
* IPv6 parsing is now enabled when EP muxing IE.

marked this merge request as **draft**
This MR partly removes the heuristics. I need to have a closer look how this should be handled. I don’t think removing it is correct.

Thanks for the feedback! We've decided to retain the existing heuristics to preserve compatibility, while adding CVG layer functionality on top of them.

That said, per the DECT NR+ standard, only the CVG layer should sit directly over the DLC layer — no other layers in between. Happy to discuss further or adjust if needed.

The idea behind this configuration is to be able to set a different layer during development. Keeping the configuration and add some simple heuristics to default use the CVG layer in "Auto" is fine, the default should always follow spec. The option to manually select IPv6, 6LoWPAN or data would be nice to keep.
